ei.title: Behavior as a Reflection of Identity
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Your behaviors are usually a reflection of your identity. What you do is an indication of the type of person you believe that you are — either consciously or nonconsciously. Research has shown that once a person believes in a particular aspect of their identity, they are more likely to act according to that belief. For example, people who identified as "being a voter" were more likely to vote than those who simply claimed "voting" was an action they wanted to perform. Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to convince themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. After all, when your behavior and your identity perfectly match, you are no longer pursuing behavior change. You are simply acting like the type of person you already believe yourself to be.

questions.passage: Your behaviors are usually a (A)[reflection / distortion] of your identity. What you do is an indication of the type of person you believe that you are — either consciously or nonconsciously. Research has shown that once a person believes in a (B)[random / particular] aspect of their identity, they are more likely to act according to that belief. For example, people who identified as "being a voter" were more likely to vote than those who simply claimed "voting" was an action they wanted to perform. Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to (C)[allow / convince] themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. After all, when your behavior and your identity perfectly match, you are no longer pursuing behavior change. You are simply acting like the type of person you already believe yourself to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① reflection — random — convince: (B) random(무작위의)은 particular(특정한)의 반의어
❌ ② distortion — particular — convince: (A) distortion(왜곡)은 reflection(반영)과 다른 부정적 의미
✅ ③ reflection — particular — convince: 원문 일치. 행동은 정체성의 반영(reflection), 정체성의 특정한(particular) 측면, 자신을 설득할(convince) 필요가 없다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ reflection — particular — allow: (C) allow(허용하다)는 convince(설득하다)와 다른 의미
det.tip: a reflection of your identity(정체성의 반영) / a particular aspect(특정한 측면) / convince themselves to train(훈련하도록 자신을 설득)

Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to convince themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① indication — according — pursuing: 원문 일치. 행동은 유형의 표시(indication), 믿음에 따라(according) 행동, 행동 변화를 추구하는(pursuing) 것이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② contradiction — according — pursuing: (A) contradiction(모순)은 indication(표시)과 다른 의미
❌ ③ indication — contrary — pursuing: (B) contrary(반대로)는 according(~에 따라)의 반의어
❌ ④ indication — according — achieving: (C) achieving(달성하는)은 pursuing(추구하는)과 다른 의미
det.tip: an indication of the type(유형의 표시) / act according to(~에 따라 행동) / pursuing behavior change(행동 변화를 추구)

Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to convince themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. After all, when your behavior and your identity (C)[barely / perfectly] match, you are no longer pursuing behavior change. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① consciously — struggled — perfectly: (B) struggled(고군분투한)는 identified(~로 여긴)과 다른 의미
❌ ② accidentally — identified — perfectly: (A) accidentally(우연히)는 consciously(의식적으로)와 다른 의미
❌ ③ consciously — identified — barely: (C) barely(간신히)는 perfectly(완벽하게)의 반의어
✅ ④ consciously — identified — perfectly: 원문 일치. 의식적으로(consciously) 또는 무의식적으로, 투표자로 자신을 여긴(identified), 행동과 정체성이 완벽하게(perfectly) 일치하는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: either consciously or nonconsciously(의식적/무의식적으로) / people who identified as(~로 여긴 사람들) / perfectly match(완벽하게 일치)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

❌ ③ accepts — 원문 일치. 운동을 정체성의 일부로 받아들이는 사람이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ match — 원문 일치. 행동과 정체성이 완벽하게 일치한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: a particular aspect of their identity — 정체성의 특정한 측면

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 행동 변화를 '추구하는(pursuing)' 것이 아니게 된다는 맥락. abandoning(포기하는)은 다른 의미

❌ ③ train — 원문 일치. 자신을 설득하여 훈련할 필요가 없다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ abandoning — 원문은 pursuing(추구하는). abandoning(포기하는)으로 바꾸면 '더 이상 행동 변화를 포기하지 않는다'가 되어 이중부정으로 의미 혼란 ←정답

det.korean: act: (A) 연극의 막/장 / (B) 믿음에 따라 행동하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 막/장 — (B) 행동하다: (A)는 연극의 3막(three acts)이라는 공연 용어, (B)는 믿음에 따라 행동하다(act according to)라는 의미로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 법률 — (B) 행동하다: (A)의 act는 연극 맥락에서 법률이 아닌 막/장
❌ ③ (A) 막/장 — (B) 연기하다: (B)의 act는 연기가 아닌 '행동하다'라는 의미
❌ ④ (A) 종류 — (B) 사정거리: 두 의미 모두 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: act: ① (명사) 막/장 (연극) ② (동사) 행동하다 ③ (명사) 법률/법안 ④ (동사) 연기하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the qualities, beliefs, and characteristics that make a person who they are"

det.korean: identity=정체성 (사람을 그 사람답게 만드는 자질, 믿음, 특성)
det.analysis:
❌ ① behavior: behavior(행동)는 사람의 행위이지 정체성 자체가 아님
❌ ② reflection: reflection(반영)은 무언가를 비추는 것이지 정체성 정의가 아님
✅ ③ identity: identity(정체성)는 사람을 그 사람답게 만드는 자질, 믿음, 특성으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ indication: indication(표시)은 징후/표시이지 정체성 정의가 아님
det.tip: identity = 정체성. the qualities, beliefs, and characteristics가 핵심

questions.passage: Research has shown that once a person believes in a particular aspect of their identity, they are more likely to act __________ (accord) to that belief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: act according to that belief(그 믿음에 따라 행동하다)에서 'according to'는 전치사구 역할의 숙어. accord(동사/명사) → according(분사형). according to = ~에 따라
det.tip: according to + 명사 = ~에 따라. act according to = ~에 따라 행동하다

questions.passage: What you do is an indication of the type of person you believe that you are — either consciously or __________ (conscious).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: conscious → nonconsciously: either A or B 구조에서 consciously와 대비되는 부사 필요
det.analysis: 'either consciously or __________' 구조에서 consciously(의식적으로)와 or로 대비되는 부사가 필요. 원문은 nonconsciously(무의식적으로). conscious(형용사) → nonconsciously(부사형+접두사 non-). either A or B 병렬 구조에서 동일 품사(부사) 필수
det.tip: either A or B: A와 B는 동일 품사. consciously(부사) ↔ nonconsciously(부사)

questions.passage: Your behaviors are usually a reflection of your identity. What you do is an indication of the type of person you believe that you are — either consciously or nonconsciously. Research has shown that once a person believes in a particular aspect of their identity, they are more likely to act __________. For example, people who identified as "being a voter" were more likely to vote than those who simply claimed "voting" was an action they wanted to perform. Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to convince themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. After all, when your behavior and your identity perfectly match, you are no longer pursuing behavior change. You are simply acting like the type of person you already believe yourself to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: according to that belief=그 믿음에 따라 — 정체성을 믿으면 그에 따라 행동한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① regardless of their goals(목표와 무관하게): 정체성 믿음이 행동으로 이어지는 맥락과 불일치
❌ ② against their own judgment(자신의 판단에 반하여): 믿음에 따른 행동이 아닌 반대 행동
❌ ③ without any clear purpose(뚜렷한 목적 없이): 믿음에 기반한 행동이라는 맥락과 불일치
✅ ④ according to that belief(그 믿음에 따라): 원문 일치. 정체성의 특정 측면을 믿으면 그 믿음에 따라(according to) 행동할 가능성이 높다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: act according to that belief — 그 믿음에 따라 행동하다

questions.passage: Your behaviors are usually a reflection of your identity. What you do is an indication of the type of person you believe that you are — either consciously or nonconsciously. Research has shown that once a person believes in a particular aspect of their identity, they are more likely to act according to that belief. For example, people who identified as "being a voter" were more likely to vote than those who simply claimed "voting" was an action they wanted to perform. Similarly, the person who accepts exercise as the part of their identity doesn't have to convince themselves to train. Doing the right thing is easy. After all, when your behavior and your identity perfectly match, you are __________. You are simply acting like the type of person you already believe yourself to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: no longer pursuing behavior change=더 이상 행동 변화를 추구하지 않는 — 행동과 정체성이 일치하면 변화 추구가 불필요해진다
det.analysis:
❌ ① constantly struggling with self-doubt(끊임없이 자기 의심과 싸우는): 행동과 정체성의 완벽한 일치 맥락에서 부정적 의미
✅ ② no longer pursuing behavior change(더 이상 행동 변화를 추구하지 않는): 원문 일치. 행동과 정체성이 완벽히 일치하면 행동 변화를 추구할 필요가 없다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ still trying to find your true self(아직 진정한 자아를 찾고 있는): 이미 정체성과 행동이 일치한 상태에서 부적절
❌ ④ gradually losing your sense of identity(점차 정체성을 잃는): 정체성 일치 맥락과 정반대
det.tip: when behavior and identity perfectly match → no longer pursuing behavior change
